method: Read every embedded font /Encoding /Differences array with pypdf; map each /gNN glyph name to its original WinAnsi source byte decoded as Windows-1252. Replace /gNN tokens in the original extracted page strings. No OCR, guessed numeric offsets or reconstructed financial statements. The sole conflicting glyph is /g3 (space versus control byte 0x01), normalized to space. All other glyph maps agree; no unresolved /gNN tokens remain. One-to-one original PDF page numbering preserved. Original PDF and original extraction are unchanged.
